_readme: Product list for scripts/update_prices.py. Apple/Samsung products ('source') are read from the official stores in all six countries (in, us, ae, sg, uk, th). Products with "basis": "store" list one page per variant and country (type jsonld or shopify); {"manual": value} is a hand-entered price. 'compat' notes appear under 'Will it work in India?' - cc is a country code, a list, or "*" for all.
